title: Roommate Proof Binder
oneLiner: Renters build a clean proof packet for roommate, lease, and housing-lottery document disputes before applications collapse.
theme: 자산 방어 / 외로움 - renters avoiding rejection when bureaucracy misunderstands household reality.
targetUser: Renters with roommates, housing-lottery applicants, student renters, and tenant advocates dealing with confusing lease documentation.
keyUX: User lists household members, lease status, addresses, income proof, roommate exclusions, and landlord replies; the app builds a document map, appeal packet, and missing-proof script.
requiredUISections: Application risk header with deadline and disputed household member
Document vault for leases, affidavits, utility bills, and address proof
Plain-language explanation script for impossible documents
Shareable proof packet export for portal upload
sourceSignals: S6 - Reddit r/nychousinglottery, applicant says appeal was rejected after office demanded an impossible signed lease for a roommate not on the application: https://www.reddit.com/r/nychousinglottery/comments/1tck1f8/warning_for_housing_connect_applicants_with/

S7 - Reddit r/SaltLakeCity, roommate-limit changes surface affordability pressure and practical roommate/lease coordination issues: https://www.reddit.com/r/SaltLakeCity/comments/1rpz8th/raising_roommate_limits_in_slc_and_ogden_might/
stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade web app prototype called "Roommate Proof Binder" for renters who need to prove roommate and lease facts during housing applications or appeals. The first screen must be a working proof-binder workspace with an application risk header, roommate relationship map, document vault, request-vs-proof comparison, appeal timeline, explanation script composer, and portal-ready proof packet export. Use realistic sample data: NYC housing lottery appeal, roommate not listed on application, office demands an impossible signed lease at another address, 10-day deadline, utility bill, sublease screenshot, landlord email, and two missing documents. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with reassuring proof cards, clear recovery helper text, warm neutral surfaces, and one gentle accent for the upload-ready packet. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
